parameters.content:
## 🛒 Abandoned Cart Recovery

**Trigger**: Webhook POST 'cart-abandoned'
**Flow**: Abandon → Log in DB analytics → Wait 1h → Check conversion → Generate recovery email via Ollama → Log email draft in mail_queue
**Séquence**: 3 emails (1h, 24h, 48h) avec codes promo progressifs

parameters.query: INSERT INTO analytics_events (store_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ({{ $json.store_id }}, 'cart_abandoned', '{"cart_id": "{{ $json.cart_id }}", "email": "{{ $json.email }}", "total": {{ $json.total }}, "items_count": {{ $json.items_count }}}'::jsonb, NOW()) RETURNING id;

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "model": "qwen2.5:3b", "prompt": "Génère un email court et engageant pour récupérer un panier abandonné. Client: {{ $('Normalize Cart').first().json.first_name || 'cher client' }}. Articles: {{ $('Normalize Cart').first().json.items_summary }}. Total: {{ $('Normalize Cart').first().json.total }}€. Ton: amical, pas agressif. Inclus un CTA. Pas de code promo. Format: Objet: [sujet]\n\n[corps de l'email]", "stream": false, "options": { "temperature": 0.7 } }

parameters.query: INSERT INTO mail_queue (store_id, from_addr, subject, body, status, created_at) VALUES ({{ $json.store_id }}, '{{ $json.from_addr }}', 'Recovery #{{ $json.email_number }}: {{ $json.subject }}', '{{ $json.body }}', 'PENDING', NOW()) RETURNING id;

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "model": "qwen2.5:3b", "prompt": "Génère un 2e email de relance panier abandonné. Client: {{ $('Normalize Cart').first().json.first_name }}. Articles: {{ $('Normalize Cart').first().json.items_summary }}. Total: {{ $('Normalize Cart').first().json.total }}€. Inclus le code promo COMEBACK10 (-10%). Ton: un peu plus urgent mais toujours sympathique. Format: Objet: [sujet]\n\n[corps]", "stream": false, "options": { "temperature": 0.7 } }

parameters.query: INSERT INTO mail_queue (store_id, from_addr, subject, body, status, created_at) VALUES ({{ $json.store_id }}, '{{ $json.from_addr }}', 'Recovery #{{ $json.email_number }}: {{ $json.subject }}', '{{ $json.body }}', 'PENDING', NOW()) RETURNING id;
INSERT INTO analytics_events (store_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES (1, 'workflow_error', '{"workflow": "abandoned_cart", "error": "{{ $json.message }}"}'::jsonb, NOW())
